summary.description: EVE identifies 21700/58E as a 5.7Ah, 3.6V high-capacity cylindrical cell. Its specification allows 16.8A maximum discharge but explicitly says that level is not for cycle life; Battery Mooch tested the exact EVE 58E and recommends staying below 13A continuous, with 10A or lower preferred for efficiency and longevity. Do not present this high-capacity energy cell as a high-power choice. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
highlights: Exact model identity is documented; wrapper and revision continuity remain relevant.
The 13A continuous candidate is supported by exact-model vaping testing; 16.8A remains an absolute manufacturer maximum, not a recommended operating target.
This is a high-capacity energy cell, not a high-power cell.

claims.statement: The exact product identity is EVE 21700/58E (21700/58E), as named by the product source and exact-model test.
